channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Vero Beach parents sue city over infant son's remains allegedly disturbed, reburied without consent
item.description: Two Vero Beach parents have filed an amended lawsuit against the City of Vero Beach, alleging their infant son's remains were accidentally disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and then reinterred without their knowledge or consent.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to 3-2 comeback over Egypt, reaches World Cup quarterfinals
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his eighth goal of the tournament and led Argentina to an improbable 3-2 victory over Egypt on Tuesday despite trailing by two with only 11 minutes of regulation time to play.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup in 4-1 loss to Belgium at home
item.description: Charles De Ketelaere scored twice and assisted on another goal, helping Belgium expose the Americans' defensive liabilities in a 4-1 win Monday night that earned a quarterfinal berth and ended U.S. hopes for a deep World Cup run at home.

item.title: US-Belgium World Cup match draws biggest soccer audience in U.S. history with 30 million viewers
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match was the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history, Fox Sports reported, drawing more than 30 million viewers.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 Los Angeles Olympics
item.description: The IOC advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
